Chapter 136 - 136 New Year’s Day Shopping; Detection Successful

136 New Year’s Day Shopping; Detection Successful

Lin Fan did not know or care about what was happening on the internet.

In the morning, after Lin Fan left Hu Tian’s house, he drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class and brought Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian to KM Mall. He was prepared to buy them some good things.

They were really too thrifty.

Qiu Ziqian’s condition was slightly better. Lin Fan had given her a total of two million. In just over a month, she had used up 1.2 million.

As for Huang Ling’s one million, she had more than a month to spend it and still had nearly 900,000.

As it was New Year’s Day, KM Mall was full of ribbons and balloons, making it particularly festive.

All sorts of discount activities were displayed on the huge electronic display screen.

Therefore, it attracted many people to come and shop, and it was very lively.

Lin Fan had just walked into the main entrance of KM Mall when he saw the Patek Phillippe store not far away.

Hence, he walked straight over.

Patek Philippe was high-end and fashionable. The storefront was luxuriously decorated and had an atmosphere of luxury. The location was even better.

As long as one entered KM Mall, they would find it.

However, when they saw the price of any one of the Patek Philippe watches, they would stop and quickly leave.

The watches were simply too expensive.

At this time, a middle-aged man with a beer belly was looking at two watches, struggling to make a choice.

“Welcome,” the shop assistant behind him said with a smile.

Then, a light and elegant fragrance slowly drifted over.

The middle-aged man could not help but turn around.

He only saw… two curvaceous beauties strolling in.

They were Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling.

Today, Qiu Ziqian was wearing a white dress that matched her fair skin. She looked like a fairy that had descended from the heavens.

Huang Ling was wearing a pink lace dress, and with her exquisite features, she looked like a carefully made doll.

When the middle-aged man saw them, he could not take his eyes off them.

He did not even notice Lin Fan who was standing at the side.

When Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling came closer, the middle-aged man came back to his senses and pointed at a golden watch. “This one looks okay. I’ll take it.”

His tone was so relaxed and indifferent.

It was as if the person who had been sitting in the shop and thinking for nearly half an hour was not him.

“It’s 253,888 yuan in total,” the salesperson said. “Sir, are you paying by card?”

“Yes, I am.” The middle-aged man took out a bank card.

Beep!

After a soft sound, the bill appeared. The middle-aged man put the watch on his wrist.

Then, he acted as if he had just seen Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling.

The middle-aged man smiled and said, “You two beauties are not only beautiful, but you also have good taste! Be it the workmanship or the style, the Ballista is one of the best in the world. It even has the title of ‘The King of 10,000 Watches.'”

“Mhm,” Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian responded perfunctorily out of courtesy.

“Let me introduce myself. I’m the general manager of Wind Feather Media, Cai Bowen. I wonder if I have the opportunity to get to know you two beautiful ladies?”

The middle-aged man did not seem to notice their perfunctory response. As he spoke, he handed out two business cards and deliberately showed them the watch he had just bought.

Cai Bowen had just bought a watch that cost 253,888 yuan, and now, he had even revealed his identity as the general manager of Wind Feather Media.

The two beauties in front of him would definitely accept his business card.

This was the double temptation of money and status!

This was only a matter of course for Cai Bowen.

Before this, Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian were still perfunctory, but now, they were completely ignoring him.

Cai Bowen held up his business cards and felt a little awkward.

Lin Fan, who was standing at the side, did not care too much. He pointed at the watch not far away and asked, “What do you guys think of this watch?”

“It’s so beautiful!” Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian praised from the bottom of their hearts.

“This is Patek Phillipe’s PP Series,” the salesperson beside him introduced. “The same model comes in two colors, red and white. The case is made of 18k rose gold and inlaid with 347 diamonds, and the dial is a white Bali Island mother-of-pearl shell. The overall look is luxurious but pure…”

Lin Fan noticed that after the salesperson’s introduction, Huang Ling’s and Qiu Ziqian’s beautiful eyes became even brighter.

“Alright, I’ll take two then,” he said.

“Huh?” The salesperson was slightly stunned.

“I’ll have two of these watches,” Lin Fan repeated.

“Ah, ah… Alright,” the salesperson finally reacted and responded.

She had served many rich people.

However, this was the first time she had met someone who directly asked for two.

She had yet to say how much the watches cost, right?

“The price of each watch is 518,888 yuan. May I know who you are, Sir?” the salesperson quickly said.

Before she could finish, Lin Fan handed her a bank card.

Beep!

He swiped his bank card on the POS machine, and the bill appeared.

A million-yuan worth of goods was successfully purchased just like that!

How long had it been?

From the moment he entered the door to the payment… Everything was done in less than a minute!

At the same time, Lin Fan’s phone showed 103 more red packets waiting to be collected.

The salesperson was still a little confused and asked, “Sir, what colors would you like?”

“You two can choose the color you like.” Lin Fan turned to Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian.

Even though Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian had already witnessed Lin Fan’s generosity, they were still filled with excitement and sweetness.

“I want the white one,” Qiu Ziqian said.

“I want the red one,” Huang Ling said.

“If you want to attract girls, you have to show them something practical,” Lin Fan said to Cai Bowen.

Cai Bowen, who had been holding his business cards, blushed. He quickly took back the business cards and tried to cover the watch he had just bought with his sleeve. Then, he ran out.

How embarrassing!

It was too embarrassing!

Lin Fan chuckled and shook his head.

After that, he brought Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling to buy bags of clothes and cosmetics, spending a total of 1.02 million yuan.

The sky had completely darkened.

Lin Fan, Qiu Ziqian, and Huang Ling returned to Yi Ke City.

Even though they had been shopping for an entire day, Lin Fan was still full of energy.

Normally, the Jingbei Scientific Research Institute would have a holiday during the new year.

Today, however, it was a hubbub of voices.

Many famous scientists were gathered here.

“Wavelength, correct!”

“Frequency, correct!”

“It’s shaking. There’s no mistake!”

….

“The principle of the earthquake diviner, correct!”

After the last voice was heard, the venue immediately burst into a loud cheer.

Feng Zhixiang, in particular, was so happy that he jumped up.

This meant that the earthquake prediction device had really been built!

Humans could predict earthquakes in advance!

This would definitely reduce the number of disasters!

After Feng Zhixiang returned home, he was still in a good mood. Hence, he started to play with his phone.

After a while, his eyes fell on the trending title—’The Culprit, Lin Fan!’
